subject: Runbook delivery & alert governance for TiltSpace ramp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@tiltspace.com>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@tiltspace.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: TiltSpace telemetry kick — initial checklist and attachments

Hi Amelia / Rajiv,

Thanks for the time on Tuesday. As promised, attached is a quick telemetry requirements spreadsheet that will help us scope dashboards and tracing hooks for your ramp. High-level ask from our side: we want to deliver a first-pass runbook + alert routing plan and a minimal SLO dashboard before your next internal release (target week of 4/29).

What we'd like from TiltSpace before the handoff call:
- Confirmation of ingress stack (Envoy / GKE / other) + how x-request-id is propagated
- Which tracing system you prefer (Honeycomb / Jaeger / Datadog APM)
- Primary on-call rotation and PagerDuty team (or email -> PD mapping)
- Any retention / audit constraints (SOC2 mention if applicable)

I attached: TiltSpace_telemetry_requirements.xlsx (worksheet: endpoints, sample rates, retention).

Proposed timeline (can adjust):
- 4/12: share requirements (this email)
- 4/15: technical sync to review hooks & sampling
- 4/22: deliver runbook draft + dashboard skeleton
- 4/29: handoff review and sign-off

Jordan and Hannah — tagging you for owners: Jordan will lead dashboard templates, Hannah will own runbook + alert policy.

Cheers,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: TiltSpace_telemetry_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Amelia Torres <amelia@tiltspace.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@tiltspace.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Apr 2029 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TiltSpace telemetry kick — initial checklist and attachments

Thanks Ben — the spreadsheet is helpful. A few quick answers before the sync: 

- Ingress: GKE with Envoy (managed). We propagate X-Request-ID from our edge through to backend via x-request-id header; we also add traceparent when sampling.
- Tracing: we prefer Honeycomb today; we have a sampling proxy that tags 1% of requests for full traces and sends spans to Honeycomb. We can bump sample rate on demand for canaries.
- On-call: ops-eng@tiltspace.com -> that maps to our PagerDuty group "TiltSpace-Core-Platform".
- Compliance: we are SOC2 in progress; retention windows are constrained for production logs (90 days) but tracing events can be configured to 30 days initially. Audit logs need CSV export ability.

We can do the technical sync on 4/15 at 10:00 PT. Please send calendar invite and any pre-read. Also — can you provide a runbook template so our SREs can review format?

Thanks,
Amelia
Director of Platform, TiltSpace
amelia@tiltspace.com

Thanks Amelia — good context. Short note from the implementation side with owners and the concrete deliverables we talked about.

High-level plan (owners):
- Runbook (owner: Hannah Schmitt) — deliver draft runbook PDF with incident steps, pager escalation matrix, triage checklist, and recovery play for model-serving latencies. Target: 2029-04-22.
- Dashboard skeleton (owner: Jordan Blake) — SLO dashboard (request latency P50/P95/P99, token costs by model route, error-rate by route), plus a tracing sampling view. Target: 2029-04-22.
- Tracing hooks & sampling (owner: TiltSpace + Jordan) — verify X-Request-ID propagation, traceparent header mapping, and sampling tuning (start at 1% -> 5% for canary). Action: technical sync 4/15 10:00 PT.
- Alert routing (owner: Hannah & TiltSpace) — primary alerts to TiltSpace PagerDuty group, secondary to Redwood on-call with a 15-minute delay for escalations.
- Retention / audit (owner: Rajiv) — confirm retention windows and export requirements for SOC2.

I've attached a runbook template and a draft of typical alert thresholds we use for model-serving (latency > 1.5s P95, error-rate > 1% sustained 5m). See OBS_RUNBOOK_DRAFT_v1.pdf in the Drive link below.

Pre-read for the call:
- TiltSpace_telemetry_requirements.xlsx (Ben sent)
- OBS_RUNBOOK_DRAFT_v1.pdf (attached)
- Mutual action plan spreadsheet (shared in Drive)

I'll send the 4/15 invite in a minute. If TiltSpace wants different thresholds for canaries we can make them adjustable; the runbook will include an "adjust and rollback" checklist.

Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com

Attachments: OBS_RUNBOOK_DRAFT_v1.pdf (18 pages, stub)

Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runbook delivery & alert governance for TiltSpace ramp

Appreciate the plan. Couple of compliance/Qs from our side before runbook sign-off: 

- Retention: production logs must be retained 90 days; tracing events we can do 30 days but need an ad-hoc export path (CSV or NDJSON) for audit. Is Redwood able to provide periodic exports or an API to pull trace samples for archiving?
- Audit logs: we need to capture admin actions from Redwood Console (deploys, role changes) and have an export window of 180 days for audit teams.
- Data residency: currently US-only is fine for us, but flag in the runbook where region-specific routing would change.

If you can confirm the export options and include an 'audit export' sub-section in the runbook that lists steps + owner, we can sign-off on the runbook draft quickly.

Thanks — Rajiv
TiltSpace Security & Compliance
rajiv.kumar@tiltspace.com
